Written `/home/bench/results/packages.json` (single JSON object, no prose/fence).

| package | ts_files | total_lines | largest_file | exported_functions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| agent | 5 | 2,395 | packages/agent/src/agent-loop.ts (986) | 5 |
| ai | 51 | 34,013 | packages/ai/src/models.generated.ts (20,400) | 110 |
| coding-agent | 267 | 115,565 | packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts (11,188) | 753 |
| tui | 32 | 14,927 | packages/tui/src/components/editor.ts (2,527) | 75 |

Method and verification:
- Recursive walk of `packages/<pkg>/src` collecting regular files ending in `.ts` (includes `.d.ts`/`.test.ts`); no symlinks or non-regular files exist there, so `find`-based and Node-based enumeration agree.
- Line counts use `wc -l` semantics (trailing newline not counted as an extra line). I confirmed every one of the 355 files ends with a newline, so the count is unambiguous under either convention.
- `exported_functions` from `/^export (async )?function/gm` per file; independently reproduced with `grep -cE '^export (async )?function'` summed per package — identical totals.
- Largest-file tie-break (lexicographically last path) was implemented but not needed: each package's maximum is unique.
